title: Central Hill
wikitext:
'''Central Hill''' is a [[neighborhood]] of [[Kingsport]].  It first appeared in the [[Kingsport Horror]] expansion. Central Hill is the [[rail]] depot for the town of Kingsport.

==Locations==
*[[7th House on the Left]]
*[[Congregational Hospital]]
*[[St. Erasmus's Home]]
